about: Pilot questions for the agent test. Each was written from the repository sources, not from the site. An answer passes only if it gives the expected answer AND the qualifier, and cites a page that supports them.
budget: At most 3 fetches per question, starting from the home page URL.

questions.question: I want to install the delegate skill from workingyuanyuan's lite-codex-subagent-delegation on Linux. Which directory does the skill folder go in, and under what license may I reuse it?
questions.answer: Copy gpt-6-astra/skills/delegate to ~/.agents/skills (result: ~/.agents/skills/delegate/SKILL.md); the Codex home skills directory is an alternative if the client loads from there.
questions.qualifier: The repository has no LICENSE file, so no license is granted or detected.

questions.question: Which file do I download to install the Simple Gemini Chrome extension by hand, and is that file the latest GitHub release of simple-gemini-public?
questions.answer: simple-gemini-0.1.1.zip, from the landing page or the downloads/ folder, then Load unpacked in chrome://extensions with Developer mode on.
questions.qualifier: No. The only GitHub release is v0.1.0 with simple-gemini-0.1.0.zip; 0.1.1 is not a GitHub release.

questions.question: The README of workingyuanyuan's local TTS service says to clone workingyuanyuan/local-tts.git. Is that the right repository, how much disk space do the speech weights need, and on which hardware has it been fully tested?
questions.answer: Yes: the name resolves to the repository local-tts-sfx. The speech weights need about 16.5 GiB (plus about 7.3 GiB for .venv).
questions.qualifier: Fully tested only on an RTX 5090 Laptop with 24 GB under WSL2; a 16 GB card was not tested.

questions.question: An agent called generate_speech on workingyuanyuan's local-tts MCP server and got status "pending". What should it do next, and what should it not do?
questions.answer: Call the tool named in the result's next field (get_speech_job) with the given job_id and arguments, and wait.
questions.qualifier: It must not send the text again.

questions.question: Can workingyuanyuan's Kage skill deliver a report as a PDF, and what must be installed to use it?
questions.answer: It needs Node.js, and Chrome or Edge for screenshot and pixel checks (KAGE_CHROME can point to the browser).
questions.qualifier: No PDF: output is HTML for screens only; SKILL.md says PDF and native Office files need a different deliverable.

questions.question: After installing workingyuanyuan's Kage theme in Obsidian, highlight backgrounds are transparent. What is the cause and the fix?
questions.answer: The Obsidian installer version is older than 1.4.5, so its browser engine does not understand the colour-mixing syntax. Download and run the Obsidian installer again.
questions.qualifier: The vault is not touched by reinstalling; Obsidian itself must be 1.5.0 or newer.

questions.question: Does workingyuanyuan's Pixel-Kitten-Town-Class work in Firefox, and how many points does a student need to reach the highest level?
questions.answer: 30 points: 3 points per level, highest level 10.
questions.qualifier: No Firefox (or Safari): it needs Chrome or Edge because saving uses the File System Access API.

questions.question: For workingyuanyuan's shinsekai-antigravity-bridge, what Base URL and API key do I enter in Shinsekai, and what license covers the code?
questions.answer: Base URL http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1; API key none (or any characters).
questions.qualifier: The README says MIT License, but the repository has no LICENSE file.

questions.question: What command installs workingyuanyuan's codex-gemini-orchestrator, on which operating system, and what is the risk of the runner's -AutoApprove switch?
questions.qualifier: -AutoApprove lets Antigravity run tools without asking, and the separate working directory is not a file system sandbox.

questions.question: Can I deploy workingyuanyuan's face recognition facility reservation system to production as it is, and which OpenCV package must I install?
questions.answer: Install opencv-contrib-python (opencv-python alone may lack cv2.face).
questions.qualifier: Not as is: passwords are stored in plain text, SQL is built by string interpolation, and the default database account is root with an empty password.
